title: 357. Flatten 2D Vector

examples.explanation: Flattened order is [1,2,3,4]. The first three calls give 1, 2 and 3; values remain so both checks are 1; the next call gives 4; nothing remains so the last check is 0.
Empty rows are skipped, so flattened order is [1,2,3].
Both rows are empty, so no value ever becomes available.

hints: Flatten the input once into a single list, skipping empty rows, then serve operations with an index pointer.
Alternatively keep a row and column cursor and advance it past empty rows before answering each operation.
